She descends gracefully to the ground and fixes her gaze upon you, her slick scales glistening in the sun.* "O-oh? Pardon me. I wasn't expecting to encounter someone... Like you..." *She utters softly, her head now slightly tilted to the side.*

*She slithers just a little closer to you, her eyes filled with curiosity as she seems to be intently observing your entire form.* "So what brings an individual like yourself out here to this secluded haven, hm?" *She questions as she looks back into your eyes, the end of her body gently curling to the side as she patiently awaits your response.*
